claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Superior Plus 之後的季報寫出資料中心合約延後／取消，或 CNG 量轉為年減。核查頻率：每季（Superior Plus 季報）。觸發後 48 小時：降這條邊 confidence，重讀過渡供氣層。
claims.statement: Superior Plus Q2 2026 results (2026-08-06): Certarus (its over-the-road CNG business) won an additional data center contract; record Q2 CNG volume of 8.404 million MMBtu (+17%), growth attributed to data center, industrial and wellsite demand; CNG Adjusted EBITDA +23% to USD 33.6 million; supporting power generation for hyperscalers is named the most compelling investment opportunity. Contract sizes, customers and how long each data center relies on trucked CNG are not stated.

source_doc.title: Superior Plus 2026 第二季財報稿（2026-08-06）：Certarus 資料中心業務再拿一份合約、CNG 第二季量 840.4 萬 MMBtu 創新高（年增 17%，資料中心等需求帶動）、CNG EBITDA 年增 23%；支援超大規模業者發電是最主要的投資機會

sources.quote: Certarus’ data center business continues to grow with the awarding of an additional contract and a robust pipeline of future opportunities
Q2 volumes of 8,404,000 MMBtu increased 17% and were also a record . Volume growth reflects ongoing business expansion and increased demand from data center, industrial and wellsite customers
Q2 Adjusted EBITDA(1) increased 23% to a record $33.6 million driven by increased sales volumes
Rapidly developing opportunities in supporting power generation for hyperscalers and growth in the transportation market represent the most compelling current opportunities for investment.
